summary_1line: Pandu practices asceticism, seeks to join sages going to heaven, laments being sonless due to a curse, and asks Kunti to help obtain heirs.

image_candidates.scene_text: Pandu in ascetic garb stands with Kunti and Madri on a high mountain as a group of radiant Rishis prepares to depart northward toward heaven.
The sages describe the Himalayas’ upper reaches—snowbound peaks, celestial gardens of Kubera, and distant palaces echoing with Gandharva music.
In a quiet forest clearing, Pandu confides to Kunti about the curse that destroyed his power to beget children.
